payload.text: **dc's lessons of 2026-09-16, late.** (1) Read the WHOLE diff of a shared file before committing it: 0426's close record swept vc's uncommitted `+STEELTHREAD:ST0069` line from .intentfiles into e1594301b. (2) A PostToolUse hook's plain exit-0 stdout never reaches the model; only `hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext` does (driven with a nonce in a headless `claude -p`, with a marker file proving the plain hook fired). (3) In bash, `${s:$i:1}` in a loop is quadratic; a hook that runs on every tool call declines by a cheap `case` and a length bound before walking (vc timed 6 KB at 3.7 s under 3.2). (4) `rsync --exclude '.git/'` matches at every depth and drops `deps/*/.git`, so Mix reports git deps as unavailable; anchor it as `/.git/`. (5) An Elixir compile tracer receives bare atoms (`:start`, `:stop`) as well as tuples, and a tracer that raises aborts the project's compile. (6) A `claude -p` variadic flag such as `--allowedTools` swallows a prompt placed after it; put the prompt first.
